svg.title: keyguard: five layers between your keyboard and GitHub
svg.desc: The phone-sized version of the layers picture. A rail runs down the left from KEYBOARD through COMMIT and PUSH to GITHUB, and a thin crawler, small glowing dots joined by hairlines, climbs down it. Seven gates stand along it, each a row: L2 AI-agent guard, L1 pre-commit, L1 reference-transaction, L1 pre-push, L3 GitHub scanning, L5 publish check and L4 watcher. Each row shows a masked API key, the verdict BLOCKED (FOUND for the watcher, which finds keys already on GitHub) and a tag: a magenta tag for the gates that ignore git --no-verify, an outline tag for the two it skips.
